STEP 1 - Scene: An open-faced toast or bruschetta topped with arugula, mozzarella or burrata, tomato and onion, served next to a pile of sautéed cabbage or sauerkraut mixed with greens.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Toasted bread slice
- Mozzarella
- Arugula
- Tomato and onion topping
- Sautéed cabbage/onion mix
- Cooked greens (kale or spinach)
- Oil

STEP 4 - Area: Food covers about 60% of the plate.
- Bread: 22%
- Cheese: 3% (on top of the bread)
- Arugula: 8% (on top of the bread)
- Cabbage mix: 25%
- Greens: 10%

The bread and cabbage/greens footprints account for roughly 57%, which matches the ~60% coverage. The cheese and arugula sit on top of the bread, so they don't add to the plate footprint.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Bread: 117 cm² × 1.5 cm = 175 ml
- Cheese: 16 cm² × 1 cm = 16 ml
- Arugula: 42 cm² × 2 cm = 84 ml
- Tomato/onion: about 30 ml
- Cabbage: 132 cm² × 2 cm = 265 ml
- Greens: 53 cm² × 2 cm = 106 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Bread (toasted slice, treated as fairly dense): 175 × 0.4 = 70 g
- Cheese: 16 × 1.0 = 16 g
- Arugula: 84 × 0.15 = 13 g
- Tomato/onion: 30 × 0.6 = 18 g
- Cabbage: 265 × 0.6 = 160 g
- Greens: 106 × 0.4 = 42 g
- Oil: about 10 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Bread: 70 g × 270 kcal/100 g = 189 kcal
- Cheese: 16 g × 280 = 45 kcal
- Arugula: 13 g × 25 = 3 kcal
- Tomato/onion: 18 g × 40 = 7 kcal
- Cabbage: 160 g × 60 = 96 kcal
- Greens: 42 g × 40 = 17 kcal
- Oil: 10 g × 884 = 88 kcal

Total ≈ 329 g and ≈ 445 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single toast plus a modest pile of vegetables at about 330 g and 445 kcal is plausible for what is visible.
